The Nasdaq fell 5.1% in one day, and its whole 2026 gain is gone.

On Friday, Nov 20, 2026, the Nasdaq Composite lost 1,225 points (5.13%) to 22,654, now negative for the year. The S&P 500 fell 3.59% to 6,918 and the Dow fell 909 points (1.85%) to 48,188 (Reuters, preliminary closes). The S&P 500 and the Dow are now more than 10% below their record closes: a correction. The S&P 500 has fallen 7 days in a row, its longest streak since February 2020. Reported trigger: fear around AI stocks, with chip stocks hit hard and Anthropic's new shares posting a steep loss on their second day of trading. Nobody knows what comes next.
